title: Salary Conversion Methodology
overview: Salary calculations convert between hourly, weekly, bi-weekly, monthly, and annual pay. Understanding gross vs net pay and effective hourly rate helps in job comparisons and budgeting.

methods.name: Standard Work Year Conversion
methods.description: Based on standard full-time work: 40 hours/week, 52 weeks/year = 2,080 hours/year. This is the most common calculation method.

formula.name: Annual ↔ Hourly Conversion
formula.expression:
Hourly = Annual / 2080
Annual = Hourly × 2080

Monthly = Annual / 12
Bi-weekly = Annual / 26
Weekly = Annual / 52

methods.name: Adjusted Work Hours Method
methods.description: Accounts for actual working hours by subtracting paid time off (PTO), holidays, and sick days from the annual total.

formula.name: Adjusted Hours
formula.expression:
Actual Hours = (52 weeks × Hours/week) - PTO Hours - Holiday Hours
Effective Hourly = Annual Salary / Actual Hours

methods.bestFor: Comparing job offers with different PTO

methods.name: Gross to Net Estimation
methods.description: Estimates take-home pay after federal, state, and local taxes plus deductions. Actual take-home varies by location and individual circumstances.

formula.name: Net Pay Estimation
formula.expression:
Net Pay ≈ Gross - Federal Tax - State Tax - FICA - Benefits

FICA = 7.65% (Social Security 6.2% + Medicare 1.45%)
formula.description: Federal tax varies by bracket; state tax varies by state (0-13%)

limitations: State and local taxes vary significantly

footnotes: Benefits like 401k and health insurance are pre-tax deductions
disclaimer: Salary calculations are estimates. Actual take-home pay depends on your tax situation, deductions, and benefits. Consult a tax professional for accurate planning.
